```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(foreign)
require(nnet)
require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)

library(stargazer)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
dt <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\ohdaw\\OneDrive - Harvard University\\tu_data\\data_reduced.csv")
dt <- as.data.frame(dt)
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
with(dt, table(NumChld, JourneyWithChildren))
```
```{r include=FALSE}
dt$JourneyWithChildren <- as.factor(dt$JourneyWithChildren) 
dt$prog <- relevel(dt$JourneyWithChildren, ref = "2")  
test <- multinom(prog ~ TravelTimeMinutes + NumChld, data = dt)
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
summary(test)
```
```{r include=FALSE}
stargazer(test, type = "html", digits=3, out="model.htm")
```


```{r echo=TRUE}
z <- summary(test)$coefficients/summary(test)$standard.errors
z
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
## extract the coefficients from the model and exponentiate
exp(coef(test))
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
head(pp <- fitted(test))
```
